notesStmt.note: This appears to be an early draft, likely written in early-to-mid 1885.

This manuscript contains draft lines for "By That Long Scan of Waves," first published along with seven other poems in The Nineteenth Century (August 1885), under the general title "Fancies at Navesink." It was later included in November Boughs (1888).
